movies.overview: A British estate agent travels to Transylvania to meet the mysterious Count Dracula, who is interested in leasing a London castle. After Dracula enslaves the agent and drives him to insanity, the pair return to London together, where Dracula, a secret bloodsucker, begins preying on socialites.
movies.title: Dracula
movies.tagline: The story of the strangest passion the world has ever known!

movies.overview: In 1979, a group of college students find a Sumerian Book of the Dead in an old wilderness cabin they've rented for a weekend getaway.
movies.title: The Evil Dead
movies.tagline: The ultimate experience in gruelling terror.

movies.overview: Withdrawn and sensitive teenager Carrie White faces bullying from classmates and abuse from her fanatically pious mother. When she begins to suspect that she has supernatural powers, things take a dark and violent turn.
movies.title: Carrie
movies.tagline: If you've got a taste for terror… take Carrie to the prom.

movies.overview: Adventurous filmmaker Carl Denham sets out to produce a motion picture unlike anything the world has seen before. Alongside his leading lady Ann Darrow and his first mate Jack Driscoll, they arrive on an island and discover a legendary creature said to be neither beast nor man. Denham captures the monster to be displayed on Broadway as King Kong, the eighth wonder of the world.
movies.title: King Kong
movies.tagline: Beauty conquered the beast!

movies.overview: Conducting clandestine experiments within the morgue at Miskatonic University, scientist Herbert West reveals to a fellow graduate student his groundbreaking work concerning the re-animation of fresh corpses.
movies.title: Re-Animator
movies.tagline: Herbert West has a good head on his shoulders...and another one on his desk.

movies.overview: Fifteen years after murdering his sister on Halloween Night 1963, Michael Myers escapes from a mental hospital and returns to the small town of Haddonfield, Illinois to kill again.
movies.title: Halloween
movies.tagline: The night he came home!

movies.overview: During its return to the earth, commercial spaceship Nostromo intercepts a distress signal from a distant planet. When a three-member team of the crew discovers a chamber containing thousands of eggs on the planet, a creature inside one of the eggs attacks an explorer. The entire crew is unaware of the impending nightmare set to descend upon them when the alien parasite planted inside its unfortunate host is birthed.
movies.title: Alien
movies.tagline: In space no one can hear you scream.

movies.overview: As the residents of the Pi Kappa Sigma sorority house prepare for the festive season, a stranger begins to harass them with a series of obscene phone calls.
movies.title: Black Christmas
movies.tagline: If this picture doesn't make your skin crawl... it's on TOO TIGHT.

movies.overview: A circus' beautiful trapeze artist agrees to marry the leader of side-show performers, but his deformed friends discover she is only marrying him for his inheritance.
movies.title: Freaks
movies.tagline: Can a full grown woman truly love a midget?

movies.overview: The mysterious Count Orlok summons a happily married real estate agent to his castle, located up in the Transylvanian mountains, to finalise a terrifying deal.
movies.title: Nosferatu
movies.tagline: A symphony of horror.

movies.overview: When larcenous real estate clerk Marion Crane goes on the lam with a wad of cash and hopes of starting a new life, she ends up at the notorious Bates Motel, where manager Norman Bates cares for his housebound mother.
movies.title: Psycho
movies.tagline: A new and altogether different screen excitement!

movies.overview: A ragtag group barricade themselves in an old Pennsylvania farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls ravaging the Northeast.
movies.title: Night of the Living Dead
movies.tagline: If it doesn't scare you, you're already dead!

movies.overview: Dr. John Markway recruits three strangers for a sleep-disorder study at the eerie and isolated Hill House. It soon becomes clear his real interest lies in the mansion itself and its sinister history, as they are forced to confront the nature of its horror…
movies.title: The Haunting
movies.tagline: You may not believe in ghosts but you cannot deny terror.

movies.overview: Thousands of birds flock into a seaside town and terrorize the residents in a series of deadly attacks.
movies.title: The Birds
movies.tagline: ...and remember, the next scream you hear may be your own!

movies.overview: Camp counselors are stalked and murdered by an unknown assailant while trying to reopen a summer camp that was the site of a child's drowning.
movies.title: Friday the 13th
movies.tagline: They were warned...They are doomed...And on Friday the 13th, nothing will save them.

movies.overview: When a Sumatran rat-monkey bites Lionel Cosgrove's mother, she's transformed into a zombie and begins killing (and transforming) the entire town while Lionel races to keep things under control.
movies.title: Braindead
movies.tagline: Some things won't stay down... even after they die.

movies.overview: A teenage boy and his friends face off against a mysterious grave robber, known only as the Tall Man, who employs a lethal arsenal of unearthly weapons.
movies.title: Phantasm
movies.tagline: If this one doesn't scare you...you're already dead!

movies.overview: During an ever-growing epidemic of zombies that have risen from the dead, two Philadelphia SWAT team members, a traffic reporter, and his television-executive girlfriend seek refuge in a secluded shopping mall.
movies.title: Dawn of the Dead
movies.tagline: When there’s no more room in HELL, the dead will walk the EARTH!

movies.overview: American tourists David and Jack are savagely attacked by an unidentified animal while hiking on the Yorkshire Moors. After retiring to the home of a beautiful nurse to recuperate, David soon begins experiencing disturbing changes to his body and mind.
movies.title: An American Werewolf in London
movies.tagline: From the director of Animal House... a different kind of animal.

movies.overview: A year after the murder of her mother, a teenage girl is terrorized by a masked killer who targets her and her friends by using scary movies as part of a deadly game.
movies.title: Scream
movies.tagline: Someone has taken their love of scary movies one step too far. Solving this mystery is going to be murder.

movies.overview: When the seaside community of Amity finds itself under attack by a dangerous great white shark, the town's chief of police, a young marine biologist, and a grizzled shark hunter embark on a desperate quest to kill the beast before it strikes again.
movies.title: Jaws
movies.tagline: The terrifying motion picture from the terrifying No. 1 best seller.

movies.overview: After a personal tragedy, Sarah joins her friends on a caving expedition in the Appalachian Mountains. But when a rockfall traps them deep underground, their adventure turns into a nightmare. As they search for a way out, the group discovers they are not alone—lurking in the darkness are savage, cave-dwelling creatures. With rising tension and dwindling trust, the women must fight to survive against both the predators and each other.
movies.title: The Descent
movies.tagline: Scream your last breath.

movies.overview: Industrialist François Delambre is called late at night by his sister-in-law, Helene, who tells him that she has just killed her husband. Reluctant at first, she eventually explains to the police that he invented a matter transportation apparatus and, while experimenting on himself, a fly entered the chamber.
movies.title: The Fly
movies.tagline: If she looked upon the horror her husband had become...She would scream for the rest of her life!

movies.overview: The deformed Phantom who haunts the Paris Opera House causes murder and mayhem in an attempt to make the woman he loves a star.
movies.title: The Phantom of the Opera
movies.tagline: The greatest horror film of modern cinema!

movies.overview: After his brother's death, Larry Talbot returns home to his father and the family estate. Events soon take a turn for the worse when Larry is bitten by a werewolf.
movies.title: The Wolf Man
movies.tagline: His hideous howl a dirge of death!

movies.overview: Five friends head out to rural Texas to visit the grave of a grandfather. On the way, they stumble across what appears to be a deserted house, only to discover something sinister within. Something armed with a chainsaw.
movies.title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre
movies.tagline: Who will survive and what will be left of them?

movies.overview: The Freelings' suburban home becomes the center of paranormal activity that opens a portal to the 'other side'. With help, they must cross over to get their daughter back.
movies.title: Poltergeist
movies.tagline: They're here.

movies.overview: Dr. Frankenstein and his monster both turn out to be alive after being attacked by an angry mob. The now-chastened scientist attempts to escape his past, but a former mentor forces him to assist with the creation of a new creature.
movies.title: Bride of Frankenstein
movies.tagline: More fearful than the monster himself!

movies.overview: A young governess for two children becomes convinced that the house and grounds are haunted by ghosts and that the children are being possessed.
movies.title: The Innocents
movies.tagline: Apparitions? Evils? Corruptions?

movies.overview: In a small English village everyone suddenly falls unconscious. When they awake every woman of child bearing age is pregnant. The resulting children have the same strange blond hair, eyes and a strong connection to each other.
movies.title: Village of the Damned
movies.tagline: What Demonic Force Lurks Behind Those Eyes?

movies.overview: When scientists exploring the Amazon River stumble on a “missing link” connecting humans and fish, they plan to capture it for later study. But the Creature has plans of his own, and has set his sights on the lead scientist's beautiful fiancée, Kay.
movies.title: Creature from the Black Lagoon
movies.tagline: From the Amazon's forbidden depths came the Creature from the Black Lagoon

movies.overview: Jack Torrance accepts a caretaker job at the Overlook Hotel, where he, along with his wife Wendy and their son Danny, must live isolated from the rest of the world for the winter. But they aren't prepared for the madness that lurks within.
movies.title: The Shining
movies.tagline: A masterpiece of modern horror.

movies.overview: Scientists and US Air Force officials fend off a blood-thirsty alien organism while investigating at a remote arctic outpost.
movies.title: The Thing from Another World
movies.tagline: Natural or Supernatural?

movies.overview: Teenagers in a small town are dropping like flies, apparently in the grip of mass hysteria causing their suicides. A cop's daughter, Nancy Thompson, traces the cause to child molester Fred Krueger, who was burned alive by angry parents many years before. Krueger has now come back in the dreams of his killers' children, claiming their lives as his revenge. Nancy and her boyfriend, Glen, must devise a plan to lure the monster out of the realm of nightmares and into the real world...
movies.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
movies.tagline: If Nancy doesn't wake up screaming, she won't wake up at all.

movies.overview: An ancient Egyptian priest named Imhotep is revived when a British archaeological expedition finds his mummy and one of the researchers accidentally reads an ancient life-giving spell. Imhotep escapes from the field site and searches for the reincarnation of the soul of his lover.
movies.title: The Mummy
movies.tagline: It Comes to Life!

movies.overview: After a bizarre and near fatal encounter with a serial killer, a newswoman is sent to a rehabilitation center whose inhabitants may not be what they seem.
movies.title: The Howling
movies.tagline: Imagine your worst fear a reality.

movies.overview: Twenty-eight days after a killer virus was accidentally unleashed from a British research facility, a small group of London survivors are caught in a desperate struggle to protect themselves from the infected. Carried by animals and humans, the virus turns those it infects into homicidal maniacs -- and it's absolutely impossible to contain.
movies.title: 28 Days Later
movies.tagline: The days are numbered.

movies.overview: A young couple, Rosemary and Guy, moves into an infamous New York apartment building, known by frightening legends and mysterious events, with the purpose of starting a family.
movies.title: Rosemary's Baby
movies.tagline: Pray for Rosemary's Baby.

movies.overview: A razor-wielding serial killer is on the loose, murdering those around Peter Neal, an American mystery author in Italy to promote his newest novel.
movies.title: Tenebre
movies.tagline: Terror Beyond Belief!

movies.overview: A television reporter and cameraman follow emergency workers into a dark apartment building and are quickly locked inside with something terrifying.
movies.title: [REC]
movies.tagline: Experience fear.

movies.overview: A Serbian émigré in Manhattan believes that, because of an ancient curse, any physical intimacy with the man she loves will turn her into a feline predator.
movies.title: Cat People
movies.tagline: She knew strange, fierce pleasures that no other woman could ever feel!

movies.overview: When Seth Brundle makes a huge scientific and technological breakthrough in teleportation, he decides to test it on himself. Unbeknownst to him, a common housefly manages to get inside the device and the two become one.
movies.title: The Fly
movies.tagline: Be afraid. Be very afraid.

movies.overview: A wealthy landowner living in Haiti convinces a sorcerer to lure the woman he has fallen for away from her fiancé. The madman later betrays their agreement by keeping the woman for himself…As a zombie.
movies.title: White Zombie
movies.tagline: Stranger things are happening than you ever dreamed of!

movies.overview: Taking an ill-advised detour en-route to California, the Carter family soon run into trouble when their RV breaks down in the middle of the desert. Stranded, they find themselves at the mercy of monstrous cannibals lurking in the surrounding hills.
movies.title: The Hills Have Eyes
movies.tagline: The lucky ones died first...

movies.original_title: What Ever Happened to Baby Jane?
movies.overview: A former vaudeville child star viciously torments her paraplegic sister in their decaying Hollywood mansion.
movies.title: What Ever Happened to Baby Jane?
movies.tagline: Sister, sister, oh so fair, why is there blood all over your hair?

movies.overview: When a mysterious entity possesses a young girl, her mother seeks the help of two Catholic priests to save her life.
movies.title: The Exorcist
movies.tagline: Something almost beyond comprehension is happening to a girl on this street, in this house…And a man has been sent for as a last resort. This man is The Exorcist.

movies.overview: A hedonistic man finds a mysterious puzzle box that summons a group of gruesome beings known as the Cenobites. These otherworldly entities open the doors to a dominion where pain and pleasure are indivisible.
movies.title: Hellraiser
movies.tagline: Demon to some. Angel to others.

movies.overview: The story of two outcast sisters, Ginger and Brigitte, in the mindless suburban town of Bailey Downs. On the night of Ginger's first period, she is savagely attacked by a wild creature. Ginger's wounds miraculously heal but something is not quite right. Now Brigitte must save her sister and save herself.
movies.title: Ginger Snaps
movies.tagline: They don't call it the curse for nothing.

movies.overview: Dr. Henry Jekyll believes that there are two distinct sides to men - a good and an evil side. He believes that by separating the two, man can become liberated. He succeeds in his experiments with chemicals to accomplish this and transforms into Hyde to commit horrendous crimes. When he discontinues use of the drug, it is already too late.
movies.title: Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
movies.tagline: Put yourself in her place! The dreaded night when her lover became a madman!

movies.overview: Immediately after their miscarriage, the US diplomat Robert Thorn adopts the newborn Damien without the knowledge of his wife. Yet what he doesn’t know is that their new son is the son of the devil.
movies.title: The Omen
movies.tagline: It is the greatest mystery of all because no human being will ever solve it.

movies.overview: The Candyman, a murderous soul with a hook for a hand, is accidentally summoned to reality by a skeptic grad student researching the monster's myth.
movies.title: Candyman
movies.tagline: We dare you to say his name five times.

movies.overview: Mary Henry ends up the sole survivor of a fatal car accident through mysterious circumstances. Trying to put the incident behind her, she moves to Utah and takes a job as a church organist. But her fresh start is interrupted by visions of a fiendish man. As the visions begin to occur more frequently, Mary finds herself drawn to the deserted carnival on the outskirts of town. The strangely alluring carnival may hold the secret to her tragic past.
movies.title: Carnival of Souls
movies.tagline: She Escaped Death. Now It Wants Her Back!

movies.overview: A sculptor opens a wax museum to showcase the likenesses of famous historical figures, but quickly runs into trouble when his business partner demands the exhibits become more extreme in order to increase profits.
movies.title: House of Wax
movies.tagline: You've never been scared until you've been scared in 3-D.

movies.overview: England, 1645. The cruel civil war between Royalists and Parliamentarians that is ravaging the country causes an era of chaos and legal arbitrariness that allows unscrupulous men to profit by exploiting the absurd superstitions of the peasants; like Matthew Hopkins, a monster disguised as a man who wanders from town to town offering his services as a witch hunter.
movies.title: Witchfinder General
movies.tagline: He'll hang, burn, and mutilate you. He's the… Witchfinder General

movies.original_title: The Return of the Living Dead
movies.overview: When two bumbling employees at a medical supply warehouse accidentally release a deadly gas into the air, the vapors cause the dead to rise again as zombies.
movies.title: The Return of the Living Dead
movies.tagline: They're Back From The Grave and Ready To Party!

movies.overview: When a disease turns all of humanity into the living dead, the last man on earth becomes a reluctant vampire hunter.
movies.title: The Last Man on Earth
movies.tagline: Do you dare imagine what it would be like to be...The last man on earth...Or the last woman.

movies.overview: Newly released from a mental ward, Jessica hopes to return to life the way it was before her nervous breakdown. But when Jessica moves to a country house with her husband and a close friend, she finds a mysterious girl living in there. Jessica's terror and paranoia resurface as evil forces surround her.
movies.title: Let's Scare Jessica to Death
movies.tagline: Something is after Jessica. Something very cold, very wet...and very dead.

movies.overview: A research team in Antarctica is hunted by a shape-shifting alien that assumes the appearance of its victims.
movies.title: The Thing
movies.tagline: Anytime. Anywhere. Anyone.

movies.overview: Two sisters return home after a stay in a mental institution, only to face disturbing events and a strained relationship with their stepmother. As eerie occurrences unfold, dark family secrets begin to surface, blurring the line between reality and nightmare.
movies.title: A Tale of Two Sisters
movies.tagline: Our sorrow was conceived long before our birth.

movies.overview: Japan is thrown into a panic after several ships are sunk near Odo Island. An expedition to the island led by Dr. Kyohei Yamane soon discover something far more devastating than imagined in the form of a 50 meter tall monster whom the natives call Gojira. Now the monster begins a rampage that threatens to destroy not only Japan, but the rest of the world as well.
movies.title: Godzilla
movies.tagline: Godzilla, a weapon of science, a great battle of wonder and terror!

movies.overview: A small-town doctor learns that the population of his community is being replaced by emotionless alien duplicates.
movies.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
movies.tagline: There was nothing to hold onto - except each other.

movies.overview: A vengeful witch, Asa Vajda, and her fiendish servant, Igor Jauvitch, return from the grave and begin a bloody campaign to possess the body of the witch's beautiful look-alike descendant: Katia. Only a handsome doctor with the help of family members stand in her way.
movies.title: Black Sunday
movies.tagline: STARE INTO THESE EYES...Discover deep within them the unspeakable, terrifying secret of BLACK SUNDAY...It will paralyze you with fright!

movies.overview: As the president of a trashy TV channel, Max Renn is desperate for new programming to attract viewers. When he happens upon "Videodrome," a TV show dedicated to gratuitous torture and punishment, Max sees a potential hit and broadcasts the show on his channel. However, after his girlfriend auditions for the show and never returns, Max investigates the truth behind Videodrome and discovers that the graphic violence may not be as fake as he thought.
movies.title: Videodrome
movies.tagline: First it controls your mind. Then it destroys your body.

movies.overview: Clarice Starling is a top student at the FBI's training academy.  Jack Crawford wants Clarice to interview Dr. Hannibal Lecter, a brilliant psychiatrist who is also a violent psychopath, serving life behind bars for various acts of murder and cannibalism.  Crawford believes that Lecter may have insight into a case and that Starling, as an attractive young woman, may be just the bait to draw him out.
movies.title: The Silence of the Lambs
movies.tagline: To enter the mind of a killer she must challenge the mind of a madman.

movies.overview: Best friends Marie and Alexia decide to spend a quiet weekend at Alexia's parents' secluded farmhouse. But on the night of their arrival, the girls' idyllic getaway turns into an endless night of horror.
movies.title: High Tension
movies.tagline: Hearts will bleed.

movies.overview: Convinced that his family is tainted by generations of evil, Roderick Usher is hellbent on stopping his sister Madeline’s wedding to prevent the cursed Usher bloodline from expanding. When her fiancé Philip Winthrop arrives at the crumbling estate to claim his bride, Roderick goes to ruthless—even deadly—lengths to keep them apart.
movies.title: House of Usher
movies.tagline: Edgar Allan Poe's demonic tale of The Ungodly... The Evil House of Usher

movies.overview: Ash Williams and his girlfriend Linda find a log cabin in the woods with a voice recording from an archeologist who had recorded himself reciting ancient chants from "The Book of the Dead." As they play the recording an evil power is unleashed taking over Linda's body.
movies.title: Evil Dead II
movies.tagline: Kiss your nerves goodbye!

movies.overview: Following an unexpected tragedy, child psychologist Malcolm Crowe meets a nine year old boy named Cole Sear, who is hiding a dark secret.
movies.title: The Sixth Sense
movies.tagline: Not every gift is a blessing.

movies.overview: Francis, a young man, recalls in his memory the horrible experiences he and his fiancée Jane recently went through. Francis and his friend Alan visit The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari, an exhibit where the mysterious doctor shows the somnambulist Cesare, and awakens him for some moments from his death-like sleep.
movies.title: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari
movies.tagline: You must become Caligari!

movies.overview: Frederick Loren invites five strangers to the party of a lifetime and offers each of them $10,000 if they can stay the night in the reportedly haunted house. Armed with a gun for protection, each guest arrives in a hearse and will either leave in it much richer…Or dead.
movies.title: House on Haunted Hill
movies.tagline: Consult your doctor! Bring your seatbelt!

movies.overview: Seven years after the death of his wife, widower Shigeharu seeks advice on how to find a new wife from a colleague. Taking advantage of their position as a film company, they stage an audition. Interviewing a series of women, Shigeharu is enchanted by the quiet Asami. But soon things take a twisted turn as Asami isn’t what she seems to be.
movies.title: Audition
movies.tagline: She always gets a part.

movies.overview: Henry Frankenstein pieces together body parts in the hope of bringing a human-like creature to life. The mad scientist’s dreams are shattered by his monstrous creation awakening with rage to a world that hates and fears him.
movies.title: Frankenstein
movies.tagline: The man who made a monster.

movies.overview: After experimenting on himself and becoming invisible, scientist Jack Griffin, now aggressive due to the drug's effects, seeks a way to reverse the experiment at any cost.
movies.title: The Invisible Man
movies.tagline: H.G. Wells’ fantastic, out-of-this-world show!

movies.overview: As a result of nuclear testing, gigantic, ferocious mutant ants appear in the American desert southwest, and a father-daughter team of entomologists join forces with the state police officer who first discovers their existence, an FBI agent and, eventually, the US Army to  eradicate the menace, before it spreads across the continent — and the world.
movies.title: Them!
movies.tagline: A horror horde of crawl-and-crush giants clawing out of the earth from mile-deep catacombs!

movies.overview: American professor John Holden arrives in London for a conference on parapsychology only to discover that the colleague he was supposed to meet was killed in a freak accident the day before. It turns out that the deceased had been investigating a cult lead by Dr. Julian Karswell. Though a skeptic, Holden is suspicious of the devil-worshiping Karswell. Following a trail of mysterious manuscripts, Holden enters a world that makes him question his faith in science.
movies.title: Night of the Demon
movies.tagline: Who will be the next in line to defy the curse?

movies.overview: While her son, Kichi, is away at war, a woman and her daughter-in-law survive by killing samurai who stray into their swamp, then selling whatever valuables they find. Both are devastated when they learn that Kichi has died, but his wife soon begins an affair with a neighbor who survived the war, Hachi. The mother disapproves and, when she can't steal Hachi for herself, tries to scare her daughter-in-law with a mysterious mask from a dead samurai.
movies.title: Onibaba
movies.tagline: The most daring film import ever...From Japan!

movies.overview: On a stormy night, young Jim, who transports a luxury car from Chicago to California to deliver it to its owner, feeling tired and sleepy, picks up a mysterious hitchhiker, who has appeared out of nowhere, thinking that a good conversation will help him not to fall asleep. He will have enough time to deeply regret such an unmeditated decision.
movies.title: The Hitcher
movies.tagline: The terror starts the moment he stops.

movies.overview: Strange things begin to occur as a tiny California coastal town prepares to commemorate its centenary. Inanimate objects spring eerily to life; Rev. Malone stumbles upon a dark secret about the town's founding; radio announcer Stevie witnesses a mystical fire; and hitchhiker Elizabeth discovers the mutilated corpse of a fisherman. Then a mysterious iridescent fog descends upon the village, and more people start to die.
movies.title: The Fog
movies.tagline: What you can't see won't hurt you...it'll kill you!

movies.overview: Five grisly tales from a 1950s-style comic, including a murdered father rising from beyond, a bizarre meteor, a vengeful husband, a mysterious crate's occupant, and a plague of cockroaches.
movies.title: Creepshow
movies.tagline: The Most Fun You'll Ever Have BEING SCARED!

movies.overview: Edinburgh, 1831. Among those who undertake the illegal trade of grave robbery is Gray, ostensibly a cab driver. Formerly a medical student convicted of grave robbery, Gray holds a grudge against Dr. MacFarlane who had escaped detection and punishment.
movies.title: The Body Snatcher
movies.tagline: GRAVES RAIDED! COFFINS ROBBED! CORPSES CARVED! MIDNIGHT MURDER! BODY BLACKMAIL! STALKING GHOULS! Mad Thrills of Terror And Macabre Mystery... –and don't blame us if you stay awake all night!

movies.overview: Alice is a withdrawn 12-year-old who lives with her mother and her younger sister, Karen, who gets most of the attention from her mother, leaving Alice out of the spotlight. When Karen is found brutally murdered in a church, suspicions start to turn toward Alice. But could a 12-year-old girl really be capable of such savagery?
movies.title: Alice, Sweet Alice
movies.tagline: If you survive this night... nothing will scare you again.

movies.overview: An American newcomer to a prestigious German ballet academy comes to realize that the school is a front for something sinister amid a series of grisly murders.
movies.title: Suspiria
movies.tagline: Do You Know Anything About Witches?

movies.overview: As the world is overrun by zombies, scientists and military personnel in an underground Florida bunker must decide on how they should deal with the undead.
movies.title: Day of the Dead
movies.tagline: The darkest day of horror the world has ever known!

movies.overview: After returning home from the Vietnam War, veteran Jacob Singer struggles to maintain his sanity. Plagued by hallucinations and flashbacks, Singer rapidly falls apart as the world and people around him morph and twist into disturbing images. His girlfriend, Jezzie, and ex-wife, Sarah, try to help, but to little avail. Even Singer's chiropractor friend, Louis, fails to reach him as he descends into madness.
movies.title: Jacob's Ladder
movies.tagline: The most frightening thing about Jacob Singer's nightmare is that he isn't dreaming.

movies.overview: Dr. Génessier is riddled with guilt after an accident that he caused disfigures the face of his daughter, the once beautiful Christiane, who outsiders believe is dead. Dr. Génessier, along with accomplice and laboratory assistant Louise, kidnaps young women and brings them to the Génessier mansion. After rendering his victims unconscious, Dr. Génessier removes their faces and attempts to graft them on to Christiane's.
movies.title: Eyes Without a Face
movies.tagline: Beautiful women were the victims of his fiendish facials.

movies.overview: Police sergeant Neil Howie is called to an island village in search of a missing girl whom the locals claim never existed. The investigation is further complicated as Howie’s religious views clash with those of the island’s residents.
movies.title: The Wicker Man
movies.tagline: Flesh to touch...Flesh to burn! Don't keep the Wicker Man waiting!

movies.overview: Traveling businessman David Mann angers the driver of a rusty tanker while crossing the California desert. A simple trip turns deadly, as Mann struggles to stay on the road while the tanker plays cat and mouse with his life.
movies.title: Duel
movies.tagline: The most bizarre murder weapon ever used!

movies.overview: Charley Brewster, a high school student, accidentally discovers the true and creepy nature of Jerry Dandrige, his dashing and enigmatic new neighbor; but no one seems willing to believe him.
movies.title: Fright Night
movies.tagline: There are some very good reasons to be afraid of the dark.

movies.overview: An American writer living in Rome witnesses an attempted murder that is connected to an ongoing killing spree in the city and conducts his own investigation, despite he and his girlfriend being targeted by the killer.
movies.title: The Bird with the Crystal Plumage
movies.tagline: All the screaming in the world won't help!

movies.overview: Ash, a handsome, shotgun-toting, chainsaw-armed department store clerk, is time warped backwards into England's Dark Ages, where he romances a beauty and faces legions of the undead.
movies.title: Army of Darkness
movies.tagline: Trapped in time. Surrounded by evil. Low on gas.

movies.overview: After kidnapping a father and his two kids, the Gecko brothers head south to a seedy Mexican bar to hide out in safety, unaware of its notorious vampire clientele.
movies.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
movies.tagline: One night is all that stands between them and freedom. But it's going to be one hell of a night.

movies.overview: After a teenager has a terrifying vision of him and his friends dying in a plane crash, he prevents the accident only to have Death hunt them down, one by one.
movies.title: Final Destination
movies.tagline: No accidents. No coincidences. No escapes. You can't cheat death.

movies.original_title: The Last House on the Left
movies.overview: On the eve of her 17th birthday, Mari and friend Phyllis set off from her family home to attend a rock concert in the city. Attempting to score some drugs on the way, the pair run afoul of a group of vicious crooks, headed up by the sadistic Krug.
movies.title: The Last House on the Left
movies.tagline: To avoid fainting keep repeating, it's only a movie... Only a movie... Only a movie...

movies.overview: A young woman inherits an old hotel in Louisiana where, following a series of supernatural "accidents", she learns that the building was built over one of the entrances to Hell.
movies.title: The Beyond
movies.tagline: Beyond death... Beyond Evil... Beyond the dreaded gates of hell.

movies.overview: Ripley, the sole survivor of the Nostromo's deadly encounter with the monstrous Alien, returns to Earth after drifting through space in hypersleep for 57 years. Although her story is initially met with skepticism, she agrees to accompany a team of Colonial Marines back to LV-426.
movies.title: Aliens
movies.tagline: This time it's war.

movies.overview: When Oskar, a sensitive, bullied 12-year-old boy, meets his new neighbor, the mysterious and moody Eli, they strike up a friendship. Initially reserved with each other, Oskar and Eli slowly form a close bond, but it soon becomes apparent that she is no ordinary young girl.
movies.title: Let the Right One In
movies.tagline: Eli is 12 years old. She's been 12 for over 200 years, and she just moved in next door.

movies.overview: An architect, visiting an English country house, realizes the other guests are familiar from his recurring nightmare. When they share their tales of the supernatural, he is filled with a growing dread.
movies.title: Dead of Night
movies.tagline: The unexpected, the tragic, the comic, the romantic, the dramatic...

movies.overview: Loner Mark Lewis works at a film studio during the day and, at night, takes racy photographs of women. Also he's making a documentary on fear, which involves recording the reactions of victims as he murders them. He befriends Helen, the daughter of the family living in the apartment below his, and he tells her vaguely about the movie he is making.
movies.title: Peeping Tom
movies.tagline: What made this the most diabolical murder weapon ever used?

movies.overview: Three tales of supernatural horror include a woman plagued by threatening phone calls, a family targeted by vampiric monsters, and a deceased medium who wreaks havoc upon the living.
movies.title: Black Sabbath
movies.tagline: A story that goes beyond the boundaries of the Supernatural to the half-world of the living dead...Where a woman's soul inhabits a fly's body...Where vampires suck only the blood of those they love dearest.

movies.original_title: The Masque of the Red Death
movies.overview: A European prince terrorizes the local peasantry while using his castle as a refuge against the "Red Death" plague that stalks the land.
movies.title: The Masque of the Red Death
movies.tagline: Horror has a face.

movies.overview: A mysterious video has been linked to a number of deaths, and when an inquisitive journalist finds the tape and views it herself, she sets in motion a chain of events that puts her own life in danger.
movies.title: Ring
movies.tagline: One curse, one cure, one week to find it.

movies.overview: After denying a woman the extension she needs to keep her home, loan officer Christine Brown sees her once-promising life take a startling turn for the worse. Christine is convinced she's been cursed by a Gypsy, but her boyfriend is skeptical. Her only hope seems to lie in a psychic who claims he can help her lift the curse and keep her soul from being dragged straight to hell.
movies.title: Drag Me to Hell
movies.tagline: Christine Brown has a good job, a great boyfriend, and a bright future. But in three days, she's going to hell.

movies.overview: An insane surgeon's obsession with an actress leads him to replace her wounded pianist husband's hands with those of a knife-throwing murderer.
movies.title: Mad Love
movies.tagline: A new, a strange, a gifted personality comes to the screen!

movies.overview: A team consisting of a physicist, his wife, a young female psychic, and the only survivor of the previous visit are sent to the notorious Hell House to prove or disprove survival after death. Previous visitors have either been killed or gone mad, and it is up to the team to survive a full week in isolation, and solve the mystery of the Hell House.
movies.title: The Legend of Hell House
movies.tagline: For the sake of your sanity, pray it isn't true!

movies.overview: Two homicide detectives are on a desperate hunt for a serial killer whose crimes are based on the "seven deadly sins" in this dark and haunting film that takes viewers from the tortured remains of one victim to the next. The seasoned Det. Somerset researches each sin in an effort to get inside the killer's mind, while his novice partner, Mills, scoffs at his efforts to unravel the case.
movies.title: Se7en
movies.tagline: Gluttony. Greed. Sloth. Envy. Wrath. Pride. Lust.

movies.overview: A wealthy New York investment banking executive hides his alternate psychopathic ego from his co-workers and friends as he escalates deeper into his illogical, gratuitous fantasies.
movies.title: American Psycho
movies.tagline: Killer looks.

movies.overview: A socially awkward veterinary assistant with a lazy eye and obsession with perfection descends into depravity after developing a crush on a boy with perfect hands.
movies.title: May
movies.tagline: If you can't find a friend... make one.

movies.overview: Taking its title from an archaic Japanese word meaning "ghost story," this anthology adapts four folk tales. A penniless samurai marries for money with tragic results. A man stranded in a blizzard is saved by Yuki the Snow Maiden, but his rescue comes at a cost. Blind musician Hoichi is forced to perform for an audience of ghosts. An author relates the story of a samurai who sees another warrior's reflection in his teacup.
movies.title: Kwaidan
movies.tagline: In the tradition of "RASHOMON" and "GATE OF HELL."

movies.overview: The residents of San Francisco are becoming drone-like shadows of their former selves, and as the phenomenon spreads, two Department of Health workers uncover the horrifying truth.
movies.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
movies.tagline: The seed is planted... terror grows.

movies.overview: A rogue scientist near a small desert town arouses the suspicion of the town's doctor when his lab assistant is found dead from a case of acromegaly, which took only four days to develop.  As the doctor investigates, aided by the scientist's new female assistant, they discover that something is devouring local cattle and humans in increasingly large quantities.
movies.title: Tarantula
movies.tagline: More terrifying than any horror known to man comes a creeping crawling monster whose towering fury no one can escape!

movies.overview: Isabella, a young model, is murdered by a mysterious masked figure at a fashion house in Rome. When her diary, which details the house employees' many vices, disappears, the masked killer begins killing off all the models in and around the house to find it.
movies.title: Blood and Black Lace
movies.tagline: A Fashion House of Models… Becomes a Terror House of Blood!

movies.overview: After a team of surgeons botches his beloved wife's operation, the distraught Dr. Phibes unleashes a score of Old-Testament atrocities on his enemies.
movies.title: The Abominable Dr. Phibes
movies.tagline: Love means never having to say you're ugly.

movies.overview: While grieving a terrible loss, a married couple meet two mysterious sisters, one of whom gives them a message sent from the afterlife.
movies.title: Don't Look Now
movies.tagline: Pass the warning.

movies.overview: An English pianist living in Rome witnesses the brutal murder of his psychic neighbor. With the help of a tenacious young reporter, he tries to discover the killer using very unconventional methods. The two are soon drawn into a shocking web of dementia and violence.
movies.title: Deep Red
movies.tagline: When was the last time you were really scared?

movies.overview: A real estate agent leaves behind his beautiful wife to go to Transylvania to visit the mysterious Count Dracula and formalize the purchase of a property in Wismar.
movies.title: Nosferatu the Vampyre
movies.tagline: It is fear and fun. It is a scream of horror and a cry of delight. It is Nosferatu, the Vampyre.

movies.overview: After a tragic event happens, composer John Russell moves to Seattle to try to overcome it and build a new and peaceful life in a lonely big house that has been uninhabited for many years. But, soon after, the obscure history of such an old mansion and his own past begin to haunt him.
movies.title: The Changeling
movies.tagline: Whatever you do… Don't go into the attic

movies.overview: Grace is a religious woman who lives in an old house kept dark because her two children, Anne and Nicholas, have a rare sensitivity to light. When the family begins to suspect the house is haunted, Grace fights to protect her children at any cost in the face of strange events and disturbing visions.
movies.title: The Others
movies.tagline: Sooner or later they’ll find you.

movies.overview: After a violent storm, a dense cloud of mist envelops a small Maine town, trapping David Drayton and his five-year-old son in a local grocery store with other local residents. They soon discover that the mist conceals deadly horrors that threaten their lives, and worse, their sanity.
movies.title: The Mist
movies.tagline: Fear changes everything.

movies.overview: First-time father Henry Spencer tries to survive his industrial environment, his angry girlfriend, and the unbearable screams of his newly born mutant child.
movies.title: Eraserhead
movies.tagline: Where your nightmares end...

movies.overview: On a stormy night, the mute servant to an ailing matriarch is stalked by a serial killer.
movies.title: The Spiral Staircase
movies.tagline: Conflicts that freeze your emotions! Suspense that takes your breath!

movies.overview: After Jonathan Harker attacks Dracula at his castle, the vampire travels to a nearby city, where he preys on the family of Harker's fiancée. The only one who may be able to protect them is Dr. van Helsing, Harker's friend and fellow-student of vampires, who is determined to destroy Dracula, whatever the cost.
movies.title: Dracula
movies.tagline: Who will his bride be tonight?

movies.overview: A child conceived by a mute servant girl transforms from an innocent youth to a killer beast at night with uncontrollable urges.
movies.title: The Curse of the Werewolf
movies.tagline: HALF-MAN...HALF-WOLF...COMPELLED BY THE HIDEOUS CURSE OF HIS EVIL BIRTH TO DESTROY EVEN THOSE WHO LOVED HIM!

movies.overview: An obsessed scientist conducts profane experiments in evolution, eventually establishing himself as the self-styled demigod to a race of mutated, half-human abominations.
movies.title: Island of Lost Souls
movies.tagline: TERROR! Stalked the Brush-Choked Island...Where Men Who Were Animals Sought the Girl Who Was All-Human!

movies.overview: One by one the archaeologists who discover the 4,000-year-old tomb of Princess Ananka are brutally murdered. Kharis, high priest in Egypt 40 centuries ago, has been brought to life by the power of the ancient gods and his sole purpose is to destroy those responsible for the desecration of the sacred tomb. But Isobel, wife of one of the explorers, resembles the beautiful princess, forcing the speechless and tormented monster to defy commands and abduct Isobel to an unknown fate.
movies.title: The Mummy
movies.tagline: Torn from the tomb to terrify the world!

movies.overview: In Whitewood, Massachusetts, a presumed witch places a curse on the town before she is burned at the stake. 300 years later, a college student arrives and checks into the mysterious Raven's Inn to research the town's history with witchcraft.
movies.title: The City of the Dead
movies.tagline: 300 years old! Human blood keeps them alive forever!

movies.overview: The Davises are expecting a baby, which turns out to be a monster with a nasty habit of killing people whenever scared. And it's easily scared.
movies.title: It's Alive
movies.tagline: There's only one thing wrong with the Davis baby...

movies.overview: God and Satan war over earth; to settle things, they wager on the soul of Faust, a learned and prayerful alchemist.
movies.title: Faust
movies.tagline: The Voice of the Tempter.

movies.overview: After a road accident in Hungary, the American honeymooners Joan and Peter and the enigmatic Dr. Werdegast find refuge in the house of the famed architect Hjalmar Poelzig, who shares a dark past with the doctor.
movies.title: The Black Cat
movies.tagline: Things you never said before nor even dreamed of!

movies.overview: After an accident, acclaimed novelist Paul Sheldon is rescued by a nurse who claims to be his biggest fan.  Her obsession takes a dark turn when she holds him captive in her remote Colorado home and forces him to write back to life the popular literary character he killed off.
movies.title: Misery
movies.tagline: Paul Sheldon used to write for a living. Now, he’s writing to stay alive.

movies.overview: A British estate agent travels to Transylvania to meet the mysterious Count Dracula, who is interested in leasing a London castle. After Dracula enslaves the agent and drives him to insanity, the pair return to London together, where Dracula, a secret bloodsucker, begins preying on socialites.
movies.title: Drácula

movies.overview: A nurse in the Caribbean turns to voodoo in hopes of curing her patient, a mindless woman whose husband she's fallen in love with.
movies.title: I Walked with a Zombie
movies.tagline: She's alive…yet dead! She's dead…yet alive!

movies.overview: Two doctors make a pact in which they swear that the first to die will return - if possible - to tell the other how to get a glimpse of the afterlife while still alive.
movies.title: Black Pit of Dr. M
movies.tagline: Plunges you into a new concept of terror ... and sudden shocks!!

movies.overview: A Scotland Yard investigator looks into four mysterious cases involving an unoccupied house.
movies.title: The House That Dripped Blood
movies.tagline: Vampires! Voodoo! Vixens! Victims!

movies.overview: A farm boy reluctantly becomes a member of the undead when a girl he meets turns out to be part of a band of vampires who roam the highways in stolen cars.
movies.title: Near Dark
movies.tagline: ...pray for daylight.

movies.overview: Tensions rise within an asbestos cleaning crew as they work in an abandoned mental hospital with a horrific past that seems to be coming back.
movies.title: Session 9
movies.tagline: Fear is a place.

movies.overview: Baron Victor Frankenstein has discovered life's secret and unleashed a blood-curdling chain of events resulting from his creation: a cursed creature with a horrid face — and a tendency to kill.
movies.title: The Curse of Frankenstein
movies.tagline: The creature created by man and forgotten by nature!

movies.overview: Five years after the horrible bloodbath at Camp Crystal Lake, new counselors roam the area, not sensing the ominous lurking presence that proves that the grisly legend is real.
movies.title: Friday the 13th Part 2
movies.tagline: The body count continues...

movies.overview: Devout Christians Töre and Märeta send their only daughter, the virginal Karin, and their foster daughter, the unrepentant Ingeri, to deliver candles to a distant church. On their way through the woods, the girls encounter a group of savage goat herders who brutally rape and murder Karin as Ingeri remains hidden. When the killers unwittingly seek refuge in the farmhouse of Töre and Märeta, Töre plots a fitting revenge.
movies.title: The Virgin Spring
movies.tagline: Ravished innocence... brings terrible revenge!

movies.overview: A reporter and a promiscuous young woman try to solve a series of child killings in a remote southern Italian town rife with superstition and a distrust of outsiders.
movies.title: Don't Torture a Duckling
movies.tagline: A classic tale of the perverse from director Lucio Fulci.

movies.overview: A young man, convinced he's a vampire, goes to live with his elderly and hostile cousin in a small Pennsylvanian town, where he tries to suppress his bloodlust.
movies.title: Martin
movies.tagline: He could be the boy next door...

movies.overview: Five young New Yorkers throw their friend a going-away party the night that a monster the size of a skyscraper descends upon the city. Told from the point of view of their video camera, the film is a document of their attempt to survive the most surreal, horrifying event of their lives.
movies.title: Cloverfield
movies.tagline: Some thing has found us.

movies.overview: Two men wake up to find themselves shackled in a grimy, abandoned bathroom. As they struggle to comprehend their predicament, they discover a disturbing tape left behind by the sadistic mastermind known as Jigsaw. With a chilling voice and cryptic instructions, Jigsaw informs them that they must partake in a gruesome game in order to secure their freedom.
movies.title: Saw
movies.tagline: How much blood would you shed to stay alive?

movies.overview: When legendary hunter Bob Rainsford is shipwrecked on the perilous reefs surrounding a mysterious island, he finds himself the guest of the reclusive and eccentric Count Zaroff. While he is very gracious at first, Zaroff eventually forces Rainsford and two other shipwreck survivors, brother and sister Eve and Martin Towbridge, to participate in a sadistic game of cat and mouse in which they are the prey and he is the hunter.
movies.title: The Most Dangerous Game
movies.tagline: They saw the heads of hunted men in Zaroff's trophy room!

movies.overview: When a nobleman is threatened by a family curse on his newly inherited estate, detective Sherlock Holmes is hired to investigate.
movies.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles

movies.overview: A young teacher on her way to a position in Transylvania helps a young man escape the shackles his mother has put on him. In so doing she innocently unleashes the horrors of the undead once again on the populace, including those at her school for ladies. Luckily for some, Dr. Van Helsing is already on his way.
movies.title: The Brides of Dracula
movies.tagline: He Turned Innocent Beauty Into Unspeakable Horror.

movies.overview: In the sixteenth century, Francis Barnard travels to Spain to clarify the strange circumstances of his sister's death after she had married the son of a cruel Spanish Inquisitor.
movies.title: The Pit and the Pendulum
movies.tagline: Betrayal cuts both ways!

movies.original_title: Henry: Portrait of a Serial Killer
movies.overview: Arriving in Chicago, Henry moves in with ex-con acquaintance Otis and starts schooling him in the ways of the serial killer.
movies.title: Henry: Portrait of a Serial Killer
movies.tagline: He's not Freddy, he's not Jason...he's real.

movies.overview: A young opera singer is stalked by a deranged fan bent on killing the people associated with her to claim her for himself.
movies.title: Opera
movies.tagline: Obsession. Murder. Madness.

movies.overview: A blind concert violinist gets a cornea transplant allowing her to see again. However, she gets more than she bargained for when she realizes her new eye can see ghosts. She sets out to find the origins of the cornea and discover the fate of its former host.
movies.title: The Eye
movies.tagline: How can you believe your eyes when they're not yours?

movies.overview: After being shot in a toy store, a serial killer transfers his soul into a Good Guy doll. A mother then gifts it to her 6-year old son Andy, which unleashes terror upon the city.
movies.title: Child's Play
movies.tagline: You'll wish it was only make-believe.

movies.overview: A dangerous combination of radiation and insecticide causes the unfortunate Scott Carey to shrink, slowly but surely, until he is only a few inches tall. His home becomes a wilderness where he must survive everything from spiders living in the cellar to his beloved cat.
movies.title: The Incredible Shrinking Man
movies.tagline: A fascinating adventure into the unknown!

movies.overview: In October of 1994 three student filmmakers disappeared in the woods near Burkittsville, Maryland, while shooting a documentary. A year later their footage was found.
movies.title: The Blair Witch Project
movies.tagline: Everything you've heard is true.

movies.overview: In a remote region of Wales, five travelers beset by a relentless storm find shelter in an old mansion.
movies.title: The Old Dark House
movies.tagline: Beware the night!

movies.overview: A 20th century European village is haunted by the ghost of a murderous little girl.
movies.title: Kill, Baby... Kill!
movies.tagline: Makes you shiver & shake!

movies.overview: A quiet and inconspicuous man rents an apartment in Paris where he finds himself drawn into a rabbit hole of dangerous paranoia.
movies.title: The Tenant
movies.tagline: Apartment for rent: Quiet building. Furnished. 2 rooms. Previous tenant committed suicide.

movies.overview: Johnny Smith is a schoolteacher with his whole life ahead of him but, after leaving his fiancee's home one night, is involved in a car crash which leaves him in a coma for 5 years. When he wakes, he discovers he has an ability to see into the past, present and future life of anyone with whom he comes into physical contact.
movies.title: The Dead Zone
movies.tagline: In his mind, he has the power to see the future. In his hands, he has the power to change it.

movies.overview: Spain, 1939. In the last days of the Spanish Civil War, the young Carlos arrives at the Santa Lucía orphanage, where he will make friends and enemies as he follows the quiet footsteps of a mysterious presence eager for revenge.
movies.title: The Devil's Backbone
movies.tagline: What is a ghost?

movies.overview: The cruel and abusive headmaster of a boarding school, Michel Delassalle, is murdered by an unlikely duo -- his meek wife and the mistress he brazenly flaunts. The women become increasingly unhinged by a series of odd occurrences after Delassalle's corpse mysteriously disappears.
movies.title: Diabolique
movies.tagline: See it, be amazed at it, but...BE QUIET ABOUT IT!

movies.overview: A Shakespearean actor takes poetic revenge on the critics who denied him recognition.
movies.title: Theatre of Blood
movies.tagline: It's curtains for his critics!

movies.overview: A couple of English tourists arrive at the island of Almanzora, off the Spanish Mediterranean coast, where they discover that there are no adults in a small fishing village, only some children who stare at them and smile mysteriously.
movies.title: Who Can Kill a Child?
movies.tagline: Suddenly… They were the only adults left alive on the island

movies.overview: On the fifteenth anniversary of the exorcism that claimed Father Damien Karras' life, Police Lieutenant Kinderman's world is once again shattered when a boy is found decapitated and savagely crucified.
movies.title: The Exorcist III
movies.tagline: Do you dare walk these steps again?

movies.overview: Southern France, 19th century. Teresa, a young girl, arrives at an isolated female boarding school that is tyrannically mastered by Mrs. Fourneau, the strict headmistress, whose protective shadow haunts Luis, her weak son.
movies.title: The House That Screamed
movies.tagline: One by one they will die!

movies.overview: A brilliant but deranged neurosurgeon becomes obsessively fixated on a judge's daughter. With the help of an escaped criminal whose face he has surgically deformed, the mad man lures her, her father, and her fiancé to his isolated, castle-like home.
movies.title: The Raven
movies.tagline: The uncanny master of make-up in a new amazing shocker!

movies.overview: After an abandoned boat sails into New York harbor with a zombie aboard, a reporter teams up with the daughter of the boat's missing owner to investigate the island where he was last seen conducting research—the site of an alleged zombie outbreak.
movies.title: Zombie Flesh Eaters
movies.tagline: We are going to eat you!

movies.overview: Three stories adapted from the work of Edgar Allen Poe:  1) A man and his daughter are reunited, but the blame for the death of his wife hangs over them, unresolved.  2) A derelict challenges the local wine-tasting champion to a competition, but finds the man's attention to his wife worthy of more dramatic action.  3) A man dying and in great pain agrees to be hypnotized at the moment of death, with unexpected consequences.
movies.title: Tales of Terror
movies.tagline: A Trilogy of Shock and Horror!

movies.original_title: À Meia Noite Levarei Sua Alma
movies.overview: Zé do Caixão is an undertaker in a small Brazilian town, searching for the perfect woman to bear him a superior child. Unable to conceive with his wife, he kills her and sets out to find someone else.
movies.title: At Midnight I'll Take Your Soul

movies.overview: The Skull [from a short story by Robert Bloch, author of Psycho] is a fearsome, finely acted and moody tale of Gothic horror. The 150 year old skull of the Marquis de Sade has been taken from its grave, bringing terror to those who own it. Demonologist Christopher Maitland [Peter Cushing] is eager to add the piece to his occult collection. Despite the warnings of a friend [Christopher Lee], he's got to have it. And does he ever get it.
movies.title: The Skull
movies.tagline: When the Skull strikes you'll scream!

movies.overview: After several Catholic school pupils are murdered, a teacher who is having an affair with one of his students becomes a suspect. When other gruesome murders start occurring shortly thereafter, the teacher suspects that he may be the cause of them.
movies.title: What Have You Done to Solange?

movies.overview: The residents of a suburban high-rise apartment building are infected by parasites that turn them into mindless nymphomaniac fiends.
movies.title: Shivers
movies.tagline: Being Terrified is Just the Beginning!

movies.overview: A Harvard anthropologist is sent to Haiti to retrieve a strange powder that is said to have the power to bring human beings back from the dead. In his quest to find the miracle drug, the cynical scientist enters the rarely seen netherworld of walking zombies, blood rites and ancient curses. Based on the true life experiences of Wade Davis and filmed on location in Haiti, it's a frightening excursion into black magic and the supernatural.
movies.title: The Serpent and the Rainbow
movies.tagline: Don't Bury Me...I'm Not Dead!

movies.overview: Rebellious teen Amy defies her parents by going to a trashy carnival that has pulled into town. In tow are her boyfriend, Buzz, and their friends Liz  and Richie. Thinking it would be fun to spend the night in the campy "Funhouse" horror ride, the teens witness a murder by a deformed worker wearing a mask. Locked in, Amy and her friends must evade the murderous carnival workers and escape before it leaves town the next day.
movies.title: The Funhouse
movies.tagline: Pay to get in. Pray to get out!

movies.overview: A group of survivors take refuge in a shopping mall after the world is taken over by aggressive, flesh-eating zombies.
movies.title: Dawn of the Dead
movies.tagline: When there's no more room in Hell, the dead will walk the Earth.

movies.overview: Two doctors find their graveyard shift inundated with townspeople ravaged by sores. Among the wounded is Cherry Darling, a dancer whose leg was ripped from her body. As the invalids quickly become enraged aggressors, Cherry and her ex-boyfriend El Wray lead a team of accidental warriors into the night.
movies.title: Planet Terror
movies.tagline: Humanity's last hope… rests on a high power machine gun!

movies.overview: A team of elite commandos on a secret mission in a Central American jungle come to find themselves hunted by an extraterrestrial warrior.
movies.title: Predator
movies.tagline: Soon the hunt will begin.

movies.overview: A corrupt young man somehow keeps his youthful beauty, but a special painting gradually reveals his inner ugliness to all.
movies.title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
movies.tagline: Why did women talk about Dorian Gray in whispers?

movies.original_title: Non si deve profanare il sonno dei morti
movies.overview: When a series of murders hit the remote English countryside, a detective suspects a pair of travelers when it is actually the work of the undead, jarred back to life by an experimental ultra-sonic radiation machine used by the Ministry of Agriculture to kill insects.
movies.title: The Living Dead at Manchester Morgue
movies.tagline: They tampered with nature—now they must pay the price …

movies.overview: A man tries to uncover an unconventional psychologist's therapy techniques on his institutionalized wife, while a series of brutal attacks committed by a brood of mutant children coincides with the husband's investigation.
movies.title: The Brood
movies.tagline: The Ultimate Experience in Inner Terror.

movies.overview: On the lam, criminal Alonzo hides in the circus as The Armless Wonder – a performer who uses his feet to hurl knives. Alonzo keeps the arms he really has concealed to hide his identity. Meanwhile, ringmaster's daughter Nanon has a phobia of being touched by men, but is romantically pursued by not only Alonzo but the strongman Malabar. Alonzo's desperation to remain with Nanon will only end in tragedy.
movies.title: The Unknown
movies.tagline: Don't miss this startling spectacle!

movies.overview: In Victorian era London, the inhabitants of a family home with rented rooms upstairs fear the new lodger is Jack the Ripper.
movies.title: The Lodger
movies.tagline: PROBING EYES that marked the woman he loved for death!

movies.overview: An aging horror-movie icon's fate intersects with that of a seemingly ordinary young man on a psychotic shooting spree around Los Angeles.
movies.title: Targets
movies.tagline: TARGETS are people...and you could be one of them!

movies.overview: Lucas and Clementine live peacefully in their isolated country house, but one night they wake up to strange noise. They're not alone... and a group of hooded assailants begin to terrorize them throughout the night.
movies.title: Them
movies.tagline: They're already inside.

movies.overview: The new manager of a small-town cemetery becomes convinced that he triggered the untimely deaths of several plot owners by tampering with a certain map. When nobody believes him, he risks his sanity to play God once again and prove his point.
movies.title: I Bury the Living
movies.tagline: Out of a Time-Rotted Tomb Crawls an Unspeakable Horror!

movies.overview: A woman who may be a witch defends her husband from forces attempting to harm him.
movies.title: Night of the Eagle
movies.tagline: Do The Undead Demons Of Hell Still Arise To Terrorise The World?

movies.overview: A demonic force has chosen Freddy Krueger as its portal to the real world. Can Heather Langenkamp play the part of Nancy one last time and trap the evil trying to enter our world?
movies.title: New Nightmare
movies.tagline: This time the terror doesn't stop at the screen.

movies.overview: Rachel Keller is a journalist investigating a videotape that may have killed four teenagers. There is an urban legend about this tape: the viewer will die seven days after watching it. Rachel tracks down the video... and watches it. Now she has just seven days to unravel the mystery of the Ring so she can save herself and her son.
movies.title: The Ring
movies.tagline: Before you die, you see

movies.overview: Shaun lives a supremely uneventful life, which revolves around his girlfriend, his mother, and, above all, his local pub. This gentle routine is threatened when the dead return to life and make strenuous attempts to snack on ordinary Londoners.
movies.title: Shaun of the Dead
movies.tagline: A romantic comedy. With zombies.

movies.overview: Three people driving into Los Angeles for a Dodgers game have car trouble and pull off into an old wrecking yard where they are held at bay by a bloodthirsty psycho and his crazy girlfriend.
movies.title: The Sadist
movies.tagline: A human volcano of unpredictable terror!

movies.overview: Beautiful young manicurist Carole suffers from androphobia (the pathological fear of interaction with men). When her sister and roommate, Helen, leaves their London flat to go on an Italian holiday with her married boyfriend, Carole withdraws into her apartment. She begins to experience frightful hallucinations, her fear gradually mutating into madness.
movies.title: Repulsion
movies.tagline: The nightmare world of a virgin's dreams becomes the screen's shocking reality!

movies.overview: A New York University professor returns from a rescue mission to the Amazon rainforest with the footage shot by a lost team of documentarians who were making a film about the area's local cannibal tribes.
movies.title: Cannibal Holocaust
movies.tagline: They eat and they are eaten!

movies.overview: Grave robbing, torture, possessed nuns, and a satanic Sabbath: Benjamin Christensen's legendary film uses a series of dramatic vignettes to explore the scientific hypothesis that the witches of the Middle Ages suffered the same hysteria as turn-of-the-century psychiatric patients. But the film itself is far from serious-- instead it's a witches' brew of the scary, gross, and darkly humorous.
movies.title: Häxan
movies.tagline: But isn’t superstition still rampant among us?

movies.overview: A strange animal attack turns a botanist into a bloodthirsty monster.
movies.title: Werewolf of London
movies.tagline: Beware the Stalking Being - Half-Human - Half-Beast!

movies.overview: Aliens disguised as clowns crash land on Earth in a rural town to capture unsuspecting victims in cotton candy cocoons for later consumption.
movies.title: Killer Klowns from Outer Space
movies.tagline: It’s craazzy!

movies.original_title: Der Golem, wie er in die Welt kam
movies.overview: In 16th-century Prague, a rabbi creates the Golem - a giant creature made of clay. Using sorcery, he brings the creature to life in order to protect the Jews of Prague from persecution.
movies.title: The Golem: How He Came Into the World

movies.original_title: M - Eine Stadt sucht einen Mörder
movies.overview: In this classic German thriller, Hans Beckert, a serial killer who preys on children, becomes the focus of a massive Berlin police manhunt. Beckert's heinous crimes are so repellant and disruptive to city life that he is even targeted by others in the seedy underworld network. With both cops and criminals in pursuit, the murderer soon realizes that people are on his trail, sending him into a tense, panicked attempt to escape justice.
movies.title: M
movies.tagline: Who is the murderer?

movies.overview: A wax sculptor opens a new museum years after he is severely injured during a fire that destroyed his original collection. The disappearance of both people and corpses coincides with this grand reopening and leads a reporter to start investigating.
movies.title: Mystery of the Wax Museum
movies.tagline: The supreme thriller!

movies.overview: A pair of siblings from London [Ray Milland and Ruth Hussey] purchase a surprisingly affordable, lonely cliff-top house in Cornwall, England. Only to discover that it actually carries a ghostly price, and soon they’re caught up in a bizarre romantic triangle from beyond the grave. Rich in atmosphere, The Uninvited, directed by Lewis Allen, was groundbreaking for the seriousness with which it treated the supernatural, haunted house genre, and it remains an elegant and eerie experience, featuring a classic score by Victor Young. A tragic family past, a mysteriously locked room, cold chills, bumps in the night - this gothic Hollywood classic has it all.
movies.title: The Uninvited
movies.tagline: The Story of a Love That is Out of This World!

movies.overview: A husband murders his wife, and years later her ghost emerges from a witch's mirror to take her revenge.
movies.title: The Witch's Mirror

movies.overview: In 13th century Berzano, a legion of knights known as the Templar were executed for conducting black magic rituals and committing human sacrifices in a quest for eternal life. 700 years later, they rise from the dead and attack a group of vacationing college students who visit the remains of their abandoned monastery.
movies.title: Tombs of the Blind Dead
movies.tagline: Makes "Night of the Living Dead" Look Like a Kids' Pajama Party!

movies.overview: An adaptation of Angela Carter's fairy tales. Young Rosaleen dreams of a village in the dark woods, where Granny tells her cautionary tales in which innocent maidens are tempted by wolves who are hairy on the inside. As Rosaleen grows into womanhood, will the wolves come for her too?
movies.title: The Company of Wolves
movies.tagline: The Desire...The Fantasy...The Nightmare.

movies.original_title: The Lodger: A Story of the London Fog
movies.overview: London. A mysterious serial killer brutally murders young blond women by stalking them in the night fog. One foggy, sinister night, a young man who claims his name is Jonathan Drew arrives at the guest house run by the Bunting family and rents a room.
movies.title: The Lodger: A Story of the London Fog

movies.overview: When a leopard escapes during a publicity stunt, it triggers a series of murders.
movies.title: The Leopard Man
movies.tagline: Woman alone the victims of strange, savage killer!

movies.original_title: La casa dalle finestre che ridono
movies.overview: Stefano, a young restorer, is commissioned to save a controversial mural located in the church of a small, isolated village.
movies.title: The House with Laughing Windows
movies.tagline: ...today I portrayed the shameless one as she died...

movies.original_title: Vampyr - Der Traum des Allan Grey
movies.overview: Allan Gray, a young man fascinated by the supernatural, goes to a small village where he feels a sinister force descending upon him. There, Allan meets an old man who asks him to protect his two daughters, for one of them has been bitten by a vampire.
movies.title: Vampyr
movies.tagline: The Strange Adventure of Allan Gray

movies.overview: Six people are lured into a small Deep South town for a Centennial celebration where the residents kill them one by one as revenge for the town's destruction during the Civil War.
movies.title: Two Thousand Maniacs!
movies.tagline: Madmen crazed for carnage!

movies.overview: Verden Fell is shattered after the death of his lovely wife. But, after an unexpected encounter with Lady Rowena Trevanion, Fell soon finds himself married again. Nevertheless, his late wife's spirit seems to hang over the dilapidated abbey that Fell shares with his new bride. Lady Rowena senses that something is amiss and, when she investigates, makes a horrifying discovery -- learning that Fell's dead wife is closer than she ever imagined possible.
movies.title: The Tomb of Ligeia
movies.tagline: Even on her wedding night she must share the man she loved with the "female thing" that lived in the Tomb of the Cat!

movies.overview: Twenty years after a Valentine's Day tragedy claimed the lives of five miners, Harry Warden returns for a vengeful massacre among teen sweethearts gearing up for another party.
movies.title: My Bloody Valentine
movies.tagline: There's more than one way to lose your heart...

movies.overview: Nerdy high schooler Arnie Cunningham falls for Christine, a rusty 1958 Plymouth Fury, and becomes obsessed with restoring the classic automobile to her former glory. As the car changes, so does Arnie, whose newfound confidence turns to arrogance behind the wheel of his exotic beauty. Arnie's girlfriend Leigh and best friend Dennis reach out to him, only to be met by a Fury like no other.
movies.title: Christine
movies.tagline: How do you kill something that can't possibly be alive?

movies.overview: After the Creed family's cat is accidentally killed, a friendly neighbor advises its burial in a mysterious nearby cemetery.
movies.title: Pet Sematary
movies.tagline: Sometimes, dead is better.

movies.overview: A woman on the run from her abusive husband encounters a mysterious hitch-hiker.
movies.title: Dust Devil
movies.tagline: He's not a serial killer. He's much worse.

movies.overview: A band of soldiers is dispatched to war games deep in the woods. When they stumble across a rival team slaughtered in camp, they realize they're not alone.
movies.title: Dog Soldiers
movies.tagline: Six men. Full moon. No chance.

movies.overview: Twenty-eight weeks after the spread of a deadly rage virus, the inhabitants of the British Isles have lost their battle against the onslaught, as the virus has killed everyone there. Six months later, a group of Americans dare to set foot on the Isles, convinced the danger has passed. But it soon becomes all too clear that the scourge continues to live, waiting to pounce on its next victims.
movies.title: 28 Weeks Later
movies.tagline: When days turn to weeks...

movies.overview: One of the sons of late Dr. Henry Frankenstein finds his father's ghoulish creation in a coma and revives him, only to find out the monster is controlled by Ygor who is bent on revenge.
movies.title: Son of Frankenstein
movies.tagline: The black shadows of the past bred this half-man/half-demon! Creating a new and terrible juggernaut of destruction!

movies.overview: When an unsuspecting town newcomer is drawn to local blood fiends, the Frog brothers and other unlikely heroes gear up to rescue him.
movies.title: The Lost Boys
movies.tagline: Sleep all day. Party all night. Never grow old. Never die. It's fun to be a vampire.

movies.overview: In a 16th-century European town, the ruling family has been given a prophecy that, should there ever be twin boys born, the younger will murder the older; so is dismayed when twins are born to the popular baron.  The older grows to be a selfish, slovenly man, who inherits the castle at his father's death and becomes ruler over the formerly happy villagers.  He enjoys his power until he learns his younger brother is returning from abroad and, afraid of the prophecy, he determines to murder his sibling, hide his body in the "black room" - an old torture chamber sealed away behind the fireplace - and then impersonate him, right down to his withered arm.  In this way he hopes to not only avoid the prophecy, but also escape consequences of his other criminal deeds and obtain marriage to a local girl of the nobility...
movies.title: The Black Room
movies.tagline: Dead or Alive... He could kill!

movies.overview: When a nobleman is threatened by a family curse on his newly inherited estate, detective Sherlock Holmes is hired to investigate.
movies.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
movies.tagline: The Most Horror-Dripping TALE EVER WRITTEN!

movies.overview: A young woman inherits a mansion, only to discover that it is haunted by witches and evil spirits.
movies.title: The Curse of the Crying Woman
movies.tagline: She was beautiful, desirable, and not altogether human...

movies.overview: A former circus artist escapes from a mental hospital to rejoin his armless, cult leader mother, and is forced to enact brutal murders in her name.
movies.title: Santa Sangre
movies.tagline: Forget Everything You Have Ever Seen...

movies.overview: Grave robbers open the grave of the wolf man and awaken him. He doesn't like the idea of being immortal and killing people when the moon is full so tries to find Dr. Frankenstein, in the hopes that the doctor can cure him. Dr. Frankenstein has died; however, his monster is found.
movies.title: Frankenstein Meets the Wolf Man
movies.tagline: A Death Fight... Between Two Beasts!

movies.overview: London, 1761. St. Mary's of Bethlehem, a sinister madhouse, is visited by wealthy people who enjoy watching the patients confined there as if they were caged animals. Nell Bowen, one of the visitors, is horrified by the deplorable living conditions of the unfortunate inhabitants of this godforsaken place, better known as Bedlam.
movies.title: Bedlam
movies.tagline: Beauty at the mercy of madmen!

movies.overview: Air Force Colonel Kenneth Penmark and his wife, Christine, adore their daughter Rhoda, despite her secret tendency for selfishness. Christine keeps her knowledge of her daughter's darker side to herself, but when a schoolmate of Rhoda's dies mysteriously, her self-deception unravels.
movies.title: The Bad Seed
movies.tagline: For little Rhoda, murder is child's play.

movies.overview: A woman named Emily checks into a hotel and offers the bellboy $2000 to temporarily marry her. We soon find out Emily is the caretaker of a wheelchair-bound mute named Helga, who was the childhood guardian of a pair of siblings: Miriam Webster and her half-brother, Warren, who is about to inherit the estate of their late father. Who is the mysterious Emily and what are her intentions?
movies.title: Homicidal
movies.tagline: A WORD OF WARNING! Please don't reveal the ending of this picture or your friends will kill you - IF THEY DON'T, I WILL!

movies.overview: Blackmailing a young couple to assist with his horrific experiments the Baron, desperate for vital medical data, abducts a man from an insane asylum. On route the abductee dies and the Baron and his assistant transplant his brain into a corpse. The creature is tormented by a trapped soul in an alien shell and, after a visit to his wife who violently rejects his monstrous form, the creature wreaks his revenge on the perpetrator of his misery: Baron Frankenstein.
movies.title: Frankenstein Must Be Destroyed
movies.tagline: The Most Frightening Frankenstein Movie Ever!

movies.original_title: Alucarda, la hija de las tinieblas
movies.overview: A young girl's arrival at a convent after the death of her parents marks the beginning of a series of events that unleash an evil presence on the girl and her mysterious new friend, an enigmatic figure known as Alucarda. Demonic possession, Satan worship, and vampirism follows.
movies.title: Alucarda
movies.tagline: They gave their souls to Hell… but the Devil wanted MORE!

movies.overview: A psychotic man, troubled by his childhood abuse, kills and mutilates young women and local models on the streets of New York City.
movies.title: Maniac
movies.tagline: I warned you not to go out tonight!
